headline: Bangladesh Garment Worker Wage Protests Disrupt Factories
summary: Bangladesh police fired tear gas to disperse garment workers on the fourth day of wage protests, disrupting factories and transport in the nation's vital export sector.
why: Garment manufacturing is a cornerstone of Bangladesh's export economy, and labor disruptions can severely impact supply chains for global apparel brands.

impacts.name: Apparel and Garment Manufacturing
impacts.why: Factory and transport disruptions halt garment production and export operations.
